# Renderer budgets: maximum nanoseconds per frame for render_perf's
# production scenes (docs/benchmarks.md "Renderer runs"), enforced by
# .github/workflows/gpu-perf.yml on the self-hosted RTX 3060 Ti runner.
# Generated by scripts/render_budgets.py from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-10-1440p-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json:
# GPU entries are the recorded mean plus the 5 % allowance of CLAUDE.md
# §10.7 (50 µs floor below 0.2 ms); CPU entries are a flat 50 µs, which
# per-object work on the main thread would break.
# (every entry afresh 2026-11-10 at 2560 x 1440, the size the reference scenes
# gate at (ADR-0082): the mean of two rounds, a process a scene, from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-10-1440p-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second
# round; the 4K budgets' history ends with that file's predecessors)
# (gpu.taa, the pass that tonemaps, again 2026-11-10 with AgX the default tonemapper
# (ADR-0083): the mean of two rounds interleaved with the ACES build's, a process a
# scene, from reference_scenes-2026-11-10-agx-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its
# second round; no other entry moved past its noise)
# (the passes the radiance cache's blended lookup touches (ADR-0085), 2026-11-11: gpu.vis_resolve,
# gpu.transparent and the frame (gpu, gpu.span) where it moved them 1.5 % or more against #170's
# build and to within 3 % of their budgets, from the mean of two rounds interleaved with that
# build's, a process a scene: reference_scenes-2026-11-11-gi-blend-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json
# and its second round)
# (bistro_street_walk's gpu.reflect_rays, 2026-11-11, with the rays a moving camera's new
# reflection cells ask for (ADR-0087), past its budget against the reflection keys' build
# (ADR-0086), from the mean of two rounds interleaved with that build's, a process a scene:
# reference_scenes-2026-11-11-motion-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round)
# (the passes whose rays now put alpha-tested surfaces to their materials' test (ADR-0088),
# 2026-11-11, on the user's word: gpu.gi_update in every view, gpu.reflect_rays in the city's and
# Bistro's, gpu.many_turns in three of Bistro's, and the frame (gpu, gpu.span) in the city's seven
# views, three of Bistro's and two of the interior's: the 57 entries the mean of two rounds moved
# 1.5 % or more and to within 3 % of their budgets, a process a scene, from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-11-alpha-tested-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round)
# (smooth surfaces' reflections a ray a pixel, the default from 2026-11-11 (ADR-0089), on the user's
# word: gpu.reflect_rays, gpu.reflect and the frame (gpu, gpu.span), the 54 entries the mean of two
# rounds moved 1.5 % or more and to within 3 % of their budgets, a process a scene, from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-11-reflect-rays-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round.
# The city's rooftop and Bistro's street turn are then past the 6.94 ms gate at their 1 % lows
# (9.06 and 7.01 ms), and Bistro's terrace at it: the user's choice, the picture before the frame
# time, until the rays' cost is won back)
# (every entry afresh 2026-11-13, on the user's word, with the image work of ADR-0090 to ADR-0095,
# which moved most frames and added gpu.gi_filter: the mean of two rounds, a process a scene, each
# run with the desktop still (docs/benchmarks.md "The desktop shares the GPU too": the rounds of
# 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-11 above were not, which raised their means by about 2 %), from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-13-adr-0095-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round. At
# their 1 % lows Bistro's street turn (7.39 ms) and the city's rooftop (8.72) are past the 6.94 ms
# gate, the other sixteen views within it)
# (every entry afresh 2026-11-14, on the user's word, with the scenes cooked with triangles for the
# rays alone (ADR-0096: the trees' cards cut down, for the rays, to where their alpha test can pass),
# which took 0.04 to 0.07 ms off Bistro's frames and 0.27 to 0.65 ms off the city's: the mean of two
# rounds, a process a scene, each run with the desktop still, from
# reference_scenes-2026-11-14-adr-0096-win-msvc-profile-rtx3060ti.json and its second round. At
# their 1 % lows Bistro's street turn (7.34 ms) and the city's rooftop (8.03) are past the 6.94 ms
# gate, the other sixteen views within it. Bistro's street, street walk and terrace take 0.074 to
# 0.089 ms of the CPU a frame, past the flat 50 us here, as they have since 2026-11-12 and not by
# this change: the rows stand, and say so. It is Bistro's glass, 342 blended instances since
# ADR-0094, which the production path draws from the CPU, 279 of them in the street's view
# (docs/benchmarks.md "Reference scenes"))
